entities.summary: Sarah bint Yousef Al Amiri is the Minister of Education of United Arab Emirates. She is the former Minister of State for Advanced Technology within the Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology, and former Chair of the Board of Directors of the Emirates Schools Establishment. Al Amiri is also the chair of the UAE Space Agency and the United Arab Emirates Council of Scientists, and Deputy Project Manager of the Emirates Mars Mission.
